proves.claim: One sweep removes the clean item folder of a released claim and of a lapsed lease with rule claim-ended, and leaves a live claim's folder untouched.

cli.io-worktree-maintenance-claim-ended..why: Without it, dead-seat folders keep blocking items and fill the disk.

proves.claim: A dirty folder of a released claim has its diff, untracked files included, at refs/pullboard/keep/<id> named in a fact, then is removed, and a new claim gets its own folder on the branch.

cli.io-worktree-maintenance-claim-ended..why: Without it, unfinished work is lost on removal or the dirty folder blocks the next builder.
